lines.text: Same morning. Real life. Madera's reservation API just went dark.
Madera is offline. Switching to Mayfield.
No human re-prompted. Claude classified the outage and re-planned from partial state.
And before anyone calls — the property management clock advances. Maestro acts unprompted.
The Karps are thirty minutes out. Suite twelve is dispatched. Maya's horse card is placed.
